A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same G2P study, with corresponding sections, equations, four figures and nine tables. Neither supplied PDF contains appendices; both mention supplementary material that is not included.

before.justification: v1 reports original G2P segmentation experiments, ablations, efficiency measurements and qualitative predictions in Section 4, Tables 1–9 and Figure 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original G2P experimental results, including benchmark scores, component ablations, efficiency measurements and qualitative predictions.

M1.justification: Gaussian-to-point matching, scale-based boundary extraction, appearance pretraining and distillation, the segmentation architecture and training losses remain unchanged. The added notation and baseline-input explanations do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ScanNet v2, ScanNet200, ScanNet++, Matterport3D and SceneSplat-7K Gaussian reconstructions. The validation evaluations and ScanNet200 hidden-test evaluation cover the same tasks and environments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within the corresponding tables and qualitative comparisons. Table 7 retains Raw 3D Gaussians, Points with Opacity and G2P; its added input description does not establish a changed baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same splits, metrics, training budgets, hardware, batch size and hyperparameters. Table 7 replaces its ScanNet v2 validation reminder with input-construction details, without reporting a different evaluation setting.

E4.justification: The component ablation, appearance-transfer comparison, distance/neighborhood sensitivity study, class-wise analysis, qualitative cases and efficiency analysis are retained with the same evidence. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The practice of reporting single performance values is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their numerical entries, and qualitative findings are unchanged. G2P still reports 78.4 mIoU on ScanNet v2 validation, 36.6 on ScanNet200 validation and 35.5 on ScanNet200 hidden test; ablation and efficiency values also match.

T1.justification: The covariance expression and Equations 1–9 remain unchanged. Section 3.2 adds that scale is denoted by S throughout, which clarifies notation without introducing or revising mathematical definitions, reasoning or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about aligned Gaussian attributes, opacity-guided distillation, boundary extraction and segmentation improvements without 2D or language supervision.

C2.justification: Interpretations of appearance and boundary cues, neighborhood-size effects and computational overhead remain unchanged. The indoor-data restriction and explanation for omitting BFANet from ScanNet200 validation are also retained.

D1.justification: Table 7 newly explains that c' and n' are Gaussian color and normal features aggregated from neighboring points using Euclidean distance, while removing its explicit validation-set sentence. The title-page project link is removed; both versions still state that code will be released soon.

R1.justification: The same 67 cited works and research positioning are retained. Author, venue and page metadata are revised, some publication records are updated, and the 3DGS/Dr. Splat reference numbers swap; these do not constitute added or removed related work.

P1.justification: Edits clarify scale notation, rewrite part of Table 7's caption, abbreviate 3D Gaussian Splatting in the conclusion, reorder affiliation numbering and revise bibliography metadata/style. The main narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 7's longer caption shifts nearby content, the title block loses its project link, and expanded reference entries reflow across pages 9–11. All four figures and nine table structures are retained without substantive redesign.

improvement.justification: Table 7 now explains previously undefined baseline inputs and their construction, modestly improving interpretability and reproducibility; Section 3.2 also clarifies notation. Removing the project link and the caption's explicit split reminder creates small documentation drawbacks, but the concrete baseline explanation provides a limited net benefit. Scientific results and claims are unchanged, and the PDFs alone do not verify the accuracy of the revised bibliographic metadata.
